assignment.title: Practical assignment — Build three regular solids
assignment.description:
Print or trace the three original nets in this chapter. Build a regular octahedron, regular dodecahedron and regular icosahedron by folding and taping matching edges. Photograph each finished model and write a table of faces, edges, vertices and V − E + F. Describe the shape of each face and explain why all three are Platonic solids.

Upload clear photographs or a PDF of your own work. Your teacher will assess the work.
assignment.solution: Teacher rubric (100): correctly assembled models, 15 marks each (45); accurate face/edge/vertex counts, 5 marks each solid (15); Euler checks for three solids, 5 marks each (15); correct regular face descriptions and equal vertex configurations, 15; clear labelled evidence and presentation, 10. Expected F,E,V: octahedron 8,12,6; dodecahedron 12,30,20; icosahedron 20,30,12. V−E+F=2 for each.
